themes.title: Right-wing leaders rally behind restrictive birthright citizenship policies
themes.blurb: Multiple right-wing governments are intensifying efforts to restrict birthright citizenship, with the Trump administration issuing executive orders to curb 'birth tourism' and limit eligibility. Parallel moves in Hungary and Italy reflect a broader transnational push to redefine citizenship laws, often framed as a response to migration pressures.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Issued two executive orders targeting birthright citizenship and 'birth tourism,' facing legal challenges but aligning with far-right rhetoric on migration.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Debates over citizenship laws intensified amid energy crisis, with nationalist factions advocating stricter controls on residency and naturalization.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Government officials echoed anti-migration framing, linking citizenship debates to broader security concerns, particularly in response to EU migration policies.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposed 'zero tolerance' policies for illegal migration, including measures to deter birthright claims, mirroring U.S. and continental right-wing strategies.

themes.title: Far-right parties exploit migration crises for political gain
themes.blurb: The Ceuta migration surge and broader EU border tensions have become a rallying point for far-right parties across Spain, Italy, and Poland. These groups are leveraging the crisis to demand stricter border controls, often uniting with left-wing factions in opposition to shared adversaries like Morocco or the EU.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demanded Morocco's exclusion from the 2030 World Cup and opposed migrant minor redistribution, framing the crisis as an 'act of war' against Spain.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government united nationalist EU leaders to block Morocco-bound migrants, positioning Italy as a defender of European sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Proposed deporting unemployed Ukrainian men of draft age, linking migration to national security and economic strain.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticized EU migration policies and called for stricter border controls, aligning with broader far-right narratives on sovereignty.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: The Trump administration's overhaul of Head Start and parallel austerity measures in Argentina and Hungary reflect a transnational trend of right-wing governments cutting or restructuring social programs. These moves are often justified as cost-saving measures but face criticism for disproportionately impacting vulnerable populations.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Proposed sweeping changes to Head Start, reducing federal regulations and shifting control to states, sparking concerns over program quality.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Advanced reforms to privatize social services, including healthcare and pension systems, under the guise of fiscal responsibility.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Ended voluntary energy consumption cuts but faced criticism for prioritizing industrial demands over household needs during the crisis.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposed cuts to welfare programs, framing them as necessary to reduce national debt and curb 'dependency culture'.

themes.title: AfD surge reshapes German politics ahead of regional elections
themes.blurb: Germany's AfD has solidified its lead in polls ahead of the Saxony-Anhalt election, with its rise prompting debates over coalition strategies and the party's extremist ties. The trend mirrors broader far-right gains in Europe, including Sweden and France, where nationalist parties are reshaping political landscapes.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt with 41% support, prompting rival parties to reject cooperation while facing Verfassungsschutz scrutiny.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Continues to influence Swedish politics, with proposals to halt refugee resettlement and prioritize national interests.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's candidacy for 2027 presidential election, despite legal challenges, reflects far-right momentum in France.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Government faces internal divisions but maintains hardline stance on migration, aligning with broader European far-right trends.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders face internal divisions and leadership challenges
themes.blurb: Internal fractures within right-wing coalitions are becoming increasingly visible, with leadership disputes in Poland's PiS, Italy's Lega, and Argentina's La Libertad Avanza. These divisions often revolve around policy failures, electoral strategies, or personal rivalries, threatening the stability of governing alliances.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Morawiecki's potential exit and PiS's declining poll numbers highlight deep internal divisions over strategy and leadership.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Salvini's leadership faces challenges from disaffected Northern League members, with calls for a federalist overhaul.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's government faces backlash over social reforms, with allies like Karina Milei blocking resignations to maintain stability.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage's leadership and electoral strategy face scrutiny, with internal debates over coalition-building and policy direction.
